versions.changelog:
Initial release of BTCvision Daily Brief skill.

- Automatically generates a daily Bitcoin market summary using live data from BTCvision.org.
- Includes BTC price, 24h change, Fear & Greed Index, halving countdown, and AI price prediction.
- Optimized for morning briefings delivered to Telegram, Discord, or Slack channels.
- No API key required—fetches data directly from BTCvision.org’s public MCP server.
- Provides a donation reminder to support BTCvision.
